about.heroDescription: Urashaka inzu yo gukodesha cyangwa kugura mu Rwanda? Menya amazu, za villa, appartements, ubutaka, ibyumba, ibiro, amaduka n'inyubako z'ubucuruzi kuri TURAHEZA NAWE.
about.trustLine: Amahirwe yo gukodesha no kugura imitungo
about.categoriesDescription: Kuva ku cyumba kimwe kugeza ku mitungo y'ubucuruzi, shakisha aho gutura, gukorera, kugura no gushora imari.
about.introParagraph1: TURAHEZA NAWE ni urubuga ruhuza abafite imitungo, abayikodesha, abakodesha, abaguzi n'abagurisha. Intego yacu ni koroshya kubona imitungo iboneka n'amahirwe yo gushora imari mu Rwanda.
about.introParagraph2: Waba ushaka inzu y'umuryango, villa, appartement, icyumba, ubutaka, ibiro, iduka cyangwa inyubako y'ubucuruzi, urubuga rwacu rugufasha kureba amahitamo atandukanye.
about.introParagraph3: Tunagaragaza serivisi zijyanye n'ubwubatsi zitangwa na WPD Ltd ku bantu bateganya imishinga yo kubaka.
about.galleryDescription: Reba ingero z'amazu yo guturamo, aho gukorera n'ubutaka.

gallery.housesText: Shaka ahantu waheraho wita mu rugo.

about.servicesDescription: Niba uteganya kubaka cyangwa guteza imbere umutungo, menya serivisi zitangwa na WPD Ltd.

services.permitText: Ubufasha mu gutegura dosiye isaba uruhushya rwo kubaka n'inyandiko zisabwa kugira ngo ibyemezo biboneke.
services.constructionText: Serivisi zo kubaka hakurikijwe imigambi, ibisobanuro n'ibisabwa byumvikanyweho.
services.supervisionText: Gukurikirana aho imirimo igeze, ubuziranenge n'uko yubahiriza imigambi n'ibisobanuro byemejwe.
services.drawingsText: Imigambi n'ibishushanyo by'inyubako bifasha gutegura no kwiyumvisha umushinga.
services.landAdviceText: Inama ku mikoreshereze y'ubutaka, aho buherereye, uko bugerwaho n'ibiteganywa mbere yo kubugura cyangwa kububyazamo umusaruro.
services.environmentText: Ubufasha mu gusuzuma ingaruka zishobora guterwa n'umushinga no gutegura inyandiko zijyanye na zo.
services.estimationText: Kubara ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi bikenewe kugira ngo hategurwe ingengo y'imari, amasoko n'imirimo.
services.specificationsText: Ibisabwa ku bikoresho, uko imirimo ikorwa n'amahame agenderwaho mu mishinga y'ubwubatsi.

about.servicesCtaDescription: Sura WPD Ltd kugira ngo umenye byinshi kuri serivisi z'ubwubatsi n'iza tekiniki.
about.videoTitle: Kuva ku kibanza kirimo ubusa kugeza ku nzu yuzuye.
about.videoDescription: Reba intambwe z'ingenzi zo kubaka inzu, zirimo fondasiyo, inkuta n'imiterere, gushyiramo ibikoresho n'ibirangiza inyubako.

values.trustText: Dushaka gutanga amakuru asobanutse ku mitungo kugira ngo abakiriya bafate ibyemezo bazi neza amakuru bafite.

values.customerText: Dufasha abantu kubona amahirwe y'imitungo ajyanye n'ibyo bakeneye.
